name: Miss President
source:
Labrys is the student council president of Yasogami High School [Spoiler]inside the TV world[/spoiler]. She is a hardworking, serious and proactive girl who loves her school a lot and does a lot to keep it the way it is. She is a caring individual who doesn't want to hurt, let alone kill, anyone she cares about. In the Japanese version, she speaks in a Kansai accent, and in the English version in a Boston accent.

[Spoiler]In reality however, she is one of the Anti-Shadow Suppression Weapons alongside [url=/c51771]Aigis[/url]. The Yasogami High School inside the TV world and the Midnight Arena itself are both actually Labrys' dungeon, created by her desire to be understood and accepted as a normal girl.[/spoiler] 

[Edited from [url=http://megamitensei.wikia.com/wiki/Labrys]Megami Tensei Wiki[/url]]

[Spoiler]After accepting her true self, she gains the persona [Url=https://megamitensei.fandom.com/wiki/Ariadne]Ariadne[/url], who's most known for helping [Url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Theseus]Theseus[/url] escape from the [Url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Labyrinth]Minotaur's labyrinth[/url] by giving him a ball of string.[/spoiler]
